summary: Re-ran backend CRUD and WhatsApp confirmation regression tests and verified the public homepage booking flow on mobile. All executed product checks passed; Meta WhatsApp remains intentionally unconfigured.
critical_code_review_comments: Reminder worker and WhatsApp status handling are present; real Meta delivery cannot be validated without production credentials and approved templates.
test_credentials: Not applicable; no auth flow tested. /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no credentials.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ mobile booking for the live flow and deleted it by returned appointment id after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four backend tests passed. Mobile homepage booking reached confirmation successfully. Focused unit coverage validates not_configured, sent, failed, and retry WhatsApp statuses; real Meta API delivery remains untested by design.
rca of the issue: No product issue found. The browser run reported a final diagnostic failure because the test script used an incorrectly quoted JavaScript selector; booking had already succeeded and this was a test-harness error, not an application failure.
